items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Freddie Keppert was playing for a girl by the name they called Mabel Elaine... Freddie and them got to New York... I come right behind Manuel Perez and them, and went with this girl, Mabel Elaine.

ctx.x: interview with Ed Garland in Hollywood and we're just talking you're telling me why they called

you want to do well there was a fellow used to come in the club called by the name of Monti he used to give us lots of tips and the boys used to laugh at him because he was very comical old fella and we begin to call each other Monti well nobody would laugh it off when it come down to me call me Monti I got hot about it I didn't like it so from there on they begin to call me Monti and I always want to jump on the whole bed the guitar player what that was this kid ory in New York you say who was on there yeah it…
How did you happen to leave New Orleans? What happened? Well, Freddie Keppert was playing for a girl by the name they called Mabel Elaine.
